title: Dispatch: PR #546 repair - relationship producer binding and evidence discipline (F1,F2,F3,F4,F6)
description:
PR #546 review repair, relationship half. Findings F1, F2, F3, F4, F6 of the
2026-09-13 review by jbongaarts on head e73b588. Read `bd show
eshyra-o9bd.19.1.4` and the note beginning "=== PR #546 REVIEW" IN FULL before
writing code: it carries the supervisor's verification of each finding and the
design decisions D1-D3 that are already made and are NOT yours to revisit.

Authority: ADR 0020 §§3, 4; docs/design/evidence-trust-model.md ("Required
failure behavior" and "Bounded positive absence"); docs/importer-fix-protocol.md.

DO NOT TOUCH the capability half: deterministicCapabilityLedger.ts,
deterministicCapabilityContract.ts, itemExecutionReadiness.ts,
create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/, packet.ts, packetMessage.ts,
test/deterministicCapabilityLedger.test.ts. A sibling child owns those.

=== F1 (MATERIAL) Pack-owned semantics are applied across producer boundaries ===
`harness.ts` lines 33 and 75 pass ONE `getBundledDnd5eSrdRecordRelationshipManifest()`
for the whole resolved stack and `expandTypedRelationships` applies it to every
`RulesStackRecordEntry`. Add-on, override, and foreign-pack records are therefore
interpreted with the SRD producer's declarations. `test/discovery/support/
lateAmbiguityAddon.ts` already creates an add-on `feature` carrying `data.source`
and no manifest of its own; today discovery traverses it under SRD semantics.
That contradicts this bead's own rationale - relationship meaning is PACK-specific,
which is the entire reason it is a pack artifact rather than a runtime module. The
harness comment copied from field provenance ("declared per RulesRecordKind, not
per pack identity") is TRUE for provenance and FALSE here; do not preserve it.

REQUIRED (design decision D1, already made): resolve declarations by PRODUCING
PACK. `RulesStackRecordSource` carries `pack`, so a resolved record's producer is
`entry.pack` - the WINNING entry for an override; `overrideChain` holds the losers
and must NOT be consulted for semantics. `expandTypedRelationships` takes a
producer-keyed manifest SOURCE (a lookup from pack identity to manifest-or-
explicit-absence), never a single manifest. Absence is per producer and explicit:
only the SRD pack ships a manifest today, so every add-on resolves to explicit
absence, and that is the honest state rather than a gap. Never fall back to
another pack's manifest, and never infer one from base/system compatibility.

Evidence: (a) a base SRD record resolves under the SRD manifest; (b) an add-on with
no manifest does NOT inherit it and its absence is recorded; (c) an add-on carrying
its OWN differing manifest resolves under its own semantics; (d) an overriding
record is interpreted under the winning producer's manifest. Use the existing
add-on fixtures where they fit.

=== F2 (MATERIAL) Malformed declared input disappears as an empty result ===
In `resolveRecordRelationships`, a declared reference whose value is not a string
returns nothing, and a `record-name` occurrence whose declared relation sibling is
missing, non-string, or not in CONDITION_RELATION_VALUES also returns nothing.
Separately, `buildRecordRelationshipManifest` validates `decl.kind` against
RULES_RECORD_KINDS but NEVER `targetKind`, which is later used via
`as RulesRecordKind` (recordRelationships.ts:266); and
`loadRecordRelationshipManifest` casts parsed JSON straight to the interface, so a
malformed on-disk manifest becomes `no-record-with-name` instead of failing closed.

REQUIRED: every DECLARED occurrence produces a typed outcome - positive, negative,
or indeterminate. Add an indeterminate variant to the resolution union carrying a
closed reason discriminant covering at least: value-not-a-string, relation-sibling-
missing, relation-sibling-not-a-string, relation-not-recognized. Validate the
manifest's closed vocabulary (schema tag, disposition, targetResolution, kind,
targetKind) at BOTH build and load, so an unknown `targetKind` fails closed at the
loader rather than degrading into a lookup miss.

DESIGN DECISION D3, ALREADY MADE: the existing test in
`test/rules/recordRelationships.test.ts` that asserts
`expect(resolveRecordRelationships(manifest, renamed, stack)).toEqual([])` for the
renamed-sibling case is the CODIFIED DEFECT and must be REPLACED, not preserved. Its
replacement asserts the typed indeterminate outcome. Do not keep any assertion whose
expected value is an empty array standing for "a declared occurrence was skipped".

=== F3 Bounded coverage gate is one-sided ===
Only `assertRecordRelationshipDeclarationsAreLive` exists (dead-declaration check).
The design called for BOTH directions. A future importer change can emit one of the
old relationship-bearing shapes for a new kind/field occurrence with no declaration;
every existing declaration stays live, the gate passes, and discovery silently
classifies that occurrence as nothing.

REQUIRED: enumerate the bounded population from the DELETED consumer allowlist as an
explicit, committed contract - the field shapes `data.source`, `data.parentClass`,
`data.progressionTableRef`, `data.tableRefs[]`, `data.spellTableRefs[]`,
`data.statBlockRefs[]`, `data.mechanics.conditions[].condition` - derived from that
contract and NOT from the manifest under test, and fail the PRODUCTION IMPORTER when
an emitted occurrence of one of those shapes has no declaration for its kind. Keep
the dead-declaration check. This stays BOUNDED: it is a claim about those seven
shapes only. Do NOT turn it into a corpus-wide `RulesRecord.data` coverage claim -
ADR 0020 rejects that global negative explicitly.

=== F4 (MATERIAL) Durable trace drops the manifest-absence fact ===
`ExpansionTrace.relationshipManifestAbsent` (types.ts:201) is not persisted by
`ProjectedExpansionStage` / `projectExpansion` in traceProjection.ts, and runtime
shadow evidence persists the projected trace - so the fact vanishes before durable
audit. Note one boolean cannot describe a mixed stack anyway once F1 lands.

REQUIRED: persist ONE canonical, producer-qualified relationship-artifact state
through the durable trace, replacing the boolean. Round-trip evidence for a
manifest-present producer, a manifest-absent producer, AND a mixed stack, proving
the distinction survives `projectDiscoveryTrace()` and JSON encode/read. Do not
redundantly persist anything already derivable from canonical traversals or losses.

=== F6 Resolution/loss evidence is double-recorded ===
`expandTypedRelationships` resolves every stack entry to build the reverse index and
records each unresolved result and loss, then calls `manifestLinks` AGAIN per
expandable candidate and records the same unresolved result and loss a second time.
`measureDiscovery` counts `stage.losses.length`, so this corrupts measured evidence,
not just an internal list. The existing unresolved test cannot expose it because it
mutates the candidate entry while leaving the stack's source entry valid.

REQUIRED: resolve each relationship occurrence ONCE per expansion pass and reuse
that result for both inbound and outbound processing. Evidence: a stack containing
one unresolved declared edge, expanded from that source, asserting exactly ONE
canonical unresolved resolution and ONE loss for that edge; and a case varying
first-pass vs second-pass expansion so genuinely repeated PASS events stay
distinguishable from duplicate work inside one pass.

=== VERIFICATION ===
`npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing (it rewrites files). Regenerate through
the importer and run `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`; `records.json` must stay at 0
records added/removed/changed. Explain every generated diff in your report.

=== PROHIBITIONS ===
Assert identities, never counts. No corpus-wide coverage or completeness claim. No
alias/topic content (eshyra-o9bd.19.2.4 owns it). Do not weaken or delete an
existing assertion to make something pass, except the one D3 replacement named
above, which must get a STRONGER assertion in its place. If a fix needs a new parser
or extractor strategy, or creates generated churn beyond the direct consequences of
these five findings, STOP and report instead of broadening.

PER FINDING

F1 (MATERIAL, resolved): expandTypedRelationships (discovery/expansion.ts)
now takes options.relationshipManifestSource: RecordRelationshipManifestSource
| undefined (a (pack) => manifest|undefined function, new type in
discovery/types.ts) instead of options.relationshipManifest: one manifest.
Resolution is keyed by the WINNING entry.pack per stack entry (memoized in
manifestByPack), never overrideChain. harness.ts's two expandTypedRelationships
calls now pass bundledDnd5eSrdRecordRelationshipManifestSource() (new function
in discovery/harness.ts, identity-proof pattern mirroring
bundledDnd5eSrdFieldProvenanceSource exactly), overridable via new
DiscoveryRunInput.relationshipManifestSource (mirrors the existing `stack`
override). test/discovery/support/lateAmbiguityAddon.ts was updated to carry
its OWN relationship manifest and return {resolver, relationshipManifestSource}
instead of a bare resolver, since its synthetic add-on feature no longer
inherits the SRD's semantics under the fix; its 3 call sites in
discoveryStages.test.ts were updated accordingly.
PROVEN BY: test/rules/recordRelationships.test.ts describe('F1: relationship
declarations resolve per PRODUCING pack, not per stack') - 4 tests, one per
evidence case (a) base SRD record under SRD manifest even alongside an
unrelated add-on, (b) add-on with no manifest does not inherit SRD's and its
absence is recorded, (c) add-on with its OWN differing manifest resolves under
its own semantics, (d) an override is interpreted under the WINNING producer's
manifest (asserted via entry.pack/overrideChain identity AND the resolved
relation string), never the base overrideChain producer's.

F2 (MATERIAL, resolved): RelationshipResolution gained an `indeterminate`
outcome (reasons: value-not-a-string, relation-sibling-missing,
relation-sibling-not-a-string, relation-not-recognized) in
rules/recordRelationships.ts. resolveRecordRelationships now pushes a typed
indeterminate resolution at every point that used to `return` silently.
buildRecordRelationshipManifest now validates targetKind against
RULES_RECORD_KINDS (previously unchecked, so a typo'd targetKind degraded
into a Map lookup miss indistinguishable from "no record with this name").
packLoader.ts's loadRecordRelationshipManifest now runs each on-disk
declaration through a new parseRecordRelationshipDeclaration (field-by-field
type validation, mirroring parseFieldProvenanceDeclaration) instead of
`value as unknown as RecordRelationshipDeclaration`.
D3 (already-made decision): the codified defect at
test/rules/recordRelationships.test.ts's 'reads the per-occurrence relation
from the DECLARED sibling key' test - `expect(resolveRecordRelationships(
manifest, renamed, stack)).toEqual([])` - is REPLACED with a full-identity
assertion of the indeterminate outcome (outcome/sourceRecordKey/pointer/
reason:'relation-sibling-missing'/declaration, matched via
relationshipDeclarationForPointer so the assertion stays keyed to the real
declaration object rather than a re-typed literal).
PROVEN BY: the D3 replacement itself, plus new describe('F2: malformed
declared data yields a typed indeterminate outcome, never emptiness') with
one test per remaining reason (value-not-a-string,
relation-sibling-not-a-string, relation-not-recognized), each asserting the
full resolution object by identity. targetKind build-time validation is
covered by a new case in 'rejects every malformed declaration shape'.
Load-time fail-closed behavior is covered by 3 new tests in
test/packLoader.test.ts describe('loadRecordRelationshipManifest - negative
paths'): malformed targetKind, non-string pointerPrefix, and missing
declarations array.

F3 (resolved): added assertRecordRelationshipDeclarationsCoverBoundedShapes +
exported LEGACY_RELATIONSHIP_BEARING_POINTER_SHAPES (the 7 shapes from the
deleted expansion.ts::directLinks allowlist, independent of kind) to
rules/recordRelationships.ts. Wired into
scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/emit.ts's writePackToDirectory alongside the
existing assertRecordRelationshipDeclarationsAreLive, gated the same way
(options.assertRelationshipDeclarations === true, i.e. the real importer CLI
only - fixture callers of buildPack are unaffected).
PROVEN BY: new describe('F3: the bounded coverage gate is
two-directional') - one test pinning the exact 7-shape list, one proving the
shipped manifest passes, one proving that removing ONLY the (feature,
/source) declaration from a copy of the shipped manifest passes the existing
dead-declaration check (nothing went dead) while
assertRecordRelationshipDeclarationsCoverBoundedShapes throws naming
'feature/source' - the exact silent gap F3 describes.

F4 (MATERIAL, resolved): ExpansionTrace.relationshipManifestAbsent: boolean
-> relationshipArtifactByProducer: readonly RelationshipArtifactState[]
({packId, state:'present'|'absent'}, new type in discovery/types.ts), built
in expansion.ts from every distinct pack the pass actually consulted
(manifestByPack), sorted by packId. traceProjection.ts's
ProjectedExpansionStage gained the same field, copied verbatim in
projectExpansion (previously ONLY traversalEvents was copied forward; the
boolean was never persisted at all, matching the finding).
PROVEN BY: new describe('F4: producer-qualified relationship-artifact state
survives the durable trace') - 3 tests via real runDiscoveryStages calls
(present-only SRD stack, absent-only foreign-base stack, and a mixed
stack = SRD base + a foreign add-on contributing one record), each asserting
trace.expansion.relationshipArtifactByProducer by full identity AND
round-tripping through JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(projectDiscoveryTrace(trace)))
to prove survival through both the projection and JSON encode/decode.

F6 (resolved): expansion.ts now resolves each stack entry's relationship
occurrences exactly once per call to expandTypedRelationships (resolveEntry,
memoized in resolutionCache keyed by ENTRY OBJECT IDENTITY, not record key -
deliberately, so a test fixture that hands a genuinely different (mutated)
entry object still gets resolved fresh, which is what the pre-existing
'retains absent key' test's missingCandidate scenario depends on and
continues to pass unmodified). The second loop (over `expandable`
candidates) now calls resolveEntry(candidate.entry) and reuses the cached
result instead of calling manifestLinks a second time and re-pushing to
relationshipResolutions/losses.
PROVEN BY: new describe('F6: an edge is resolved once per expansion pass,
never duplicated within one pass') - one test asserting EXACTLY one
unresolved resolution and exactly one matching loss for a single unresolved
declared edge on a candidate carrying the stack's OWN entry object (the case
the old 'retains absent key' test could not expose, per the finding, because
it mutates the candidate's entry); one test calling expandTypedRelationships
TWICE over the same broken stack/candidate and asserting each independent
call still records exactly one (proving cross-pass repeats stay real events
while intra-pass duplication is gone).
